dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Oh, I love it here!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: The scenery here is so different from Mondstadt's. I find it really refreshing.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: And here, I can sing at the top of my voice without having to worry if I'm disturbing anyone! It's the best way to practice.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Surely no one would ever consider your sweet voice a disturbance?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Ah...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: It sure is nice of you to say that! But, uh... still, I always need to make sure I'm being considerate of other people.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Anyway, I'm really happy you invited me here!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's great!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Yeah... I'm just so happy that you invited me to come here.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: I think I'd like to stay here a little longer.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Oh, sure!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's with that smile...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you suddenly remembered something amusing?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Oh, I just realized that I haven't chatted with a friend like this in a long time.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: I just feel so blessed all of a sudden.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seems like you're easy to please.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Uhh... Is that so...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Well, maybe... but it's not such a bad thing.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: The easier you find it to receive joy, the more energy you have to share that joy with other people.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's because you're always putting other people first.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Of course I do, that's what I'm supposed to do!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: I've always had so many people looking out for me. I just want to do all that is within my power to repay their kindness.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You are every bit as wonderful as people say.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Ahh... please, no need to shower me with compliments...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Only with constructive criticism can we grow, right...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Oh, I've been practicing a new song recently.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: But I'm still trying to iron out a few details...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: When I repeat the chorus, should I go up a half step? I can't decide... And I think there's room for improvement with the dance routine, but I'm not sure...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: If it's no trouble, I'd really appreciate it if you could watch my performance and give me your suggestions.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You have my unconditional support.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It would be my honor.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Thank you...!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Um... Please don't laugh at me if there are parts that still need practicing.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: I've thought about this a lot of times in the past, but it's taken me this long to finally pluck up the courage to perform for you at such close distance.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: If you laughed at me, there'd be nowhere I could run from my embarrassment...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't worry. I won't laugh.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I believe in you, and you should believe in yourself as well.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Whew... Okay.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Then...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Let the show begin!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: You can come look for me anytime if you want to test something o(*￣▽￣*)ブ
